senses.gloss:
तैर्थ a. (र्थी f.) Relating to a
sacred place.

तैर्थिक a.
1 Sacred, holy.
--2
Coming from a sacred place.
--3
Frequenting sacred places or shrines.
--कः
1 An ascetic.
--2 One who
propounds a new religious or
philosophical doctrine.
--कं Holy water
(such as that brought from a
sacred bathing-place).
